data.metaTitle: Professional listings and your data — FadeUp
data.metaDescription: Why a professional listing about you exists on FadeUp, where the data comes from, your rights, and how to request the removal of the listing.
data.title: Your professional listing on FadeUp
data.intro: FadeUp lists hair professionals, including professionals who do not have an account yet. If a listing about you appears on FadeUp without you having created it, this page explains why it exists, what it contains, and how to remove it.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The data controller is FadeUp. For any question about your data, write to us:

purpose.title: Why this listing exists
purpose.body: The listing helps customers find hair professionals around them, including those who are not on FadeUp yet. This processing relies on legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR): listing a professional activity from information you have made public yourself.
purpose.unmanaged: Every listing not managed by its owner is clearly marked "Not yet managed on FadeUp". Nothing on it is invented: no availability, no reviews, no numbers that do not come from real data.

categories.title: What the listing contains
categories.body: Professional data only: professional or business name, business category, address or service area, website and public links. Photos, opening hours and rates only appear when their provenance and rights allow it.

sources.title: Where the data comes from
sources.body: Publicly accessible sources: business listings (for example Google Business), professional directories, your website and your public social media profiles. Every data point keeps its provenance in our systems.
sources.exact: You can obtain the exact source of the data on your listing by writing to the address above.

recipients.title: Who has access
recipients.body: The listing is public by nature: it is visible to FadeUp visitors. Internally, only our technical providers process the data on our behalf — hosting and email delivery. When a provider involves a transfer outside the European Union, that transfer is covered by the safeguards provided by the GDPR (standard contractual clauses). We do not sell your data.

retention.title: For how long
retention.body: The data is kept for as long as the listing is published. If you request removal, the listing is unpublished no later than 72 hours after the request is validated, and your business is neither contacted again nor republished. After a removal, we keep only what is strictly needed to honour that promise: your entry on our objection list, which prevents any republication and any further contact.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction and objection over the data concerning you. To exercise them, use the removal form below or write to us. You can also lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority (in France, the CNIL — cnil.fr).
rights.claimNote: If you would rather manage the listing yourself — correct the information, add your own — you can claim it directly from the listing.

emails.title: The emails you may receive
emails.body: When a listing about you is published, we inform you by email if a public address exists. If a customer expresses interest in your services, we forward their request by email, with at most two reminders. Every message contains an unsubscribe link: one click, and no more messages of this kind will be sent to you.

withdrawal.title: Remove your listing
withdrawal.body: Tell us which listing is concerned, and we will remove it. A team member verifies that the request really concerns your business — this is what prevents a third party from taking down someone else's listing — then the removal takes effect no later than 72 hours after that validation.
withdrawal.refHint: Paste the listing address (fade-up.com/pro/…) or its @handle.
withdrawal.refNotFound: No listing matches. Check the address or the handle.
withdrawal.refLookupFailed: The listing could not be verified. Try again.
withdrawal.refRequired: Tell us which listing to remove.
withdrawal.claimed: This listing is managed by its owner from their FadeUp account. If it is yours, sign in to control its visibility.
withdrawal.emailHint: So we can confirm the removal and reach you if we have a question.
withdrawal.successBody: The removal will take effect no later than {{deadline}}, after verification by our team.
withdrawal.alreadyPendingBody: A removal request is already recorded for this listing. It will be handled no later than {{deadline}}.

refusal.professional_is_claimed: This listing is managed by its owner from their FadeUp account: it cannot be removed through this form.
refusal.profile_not_published: This listing is not (or no longer) published on FadeUp — there is nothing to remove. To stop receiving emails, use the unsubscribe link they contain, or write to us.
refusal.invalid_email: This email address is not valid.

withdrawal.error: The request could not be recorded. Try again, or write to us: bonjour@contact.fade-up.com.

unsubscribe.title: Stop receiving these emails
unsubscribe.body: Confirm to stop receiving FadeUp emails about your professional listing: publication notices and customer requests.
unsubscribe.doneBody: You will no longer receive these emails. If you also want your listing removed, the page below explains how.
unsubscribe.error: The unsubscription could not be recorded. Try again.
